novelty_flags.label: ass:weak-selection-monotonicity and the causal comparison to DongHeiler2026
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited weak covariate-directional condition is only imposed among compliers in Dong--Heiler, whereas the core imposes it on the whole population conditional on X, an instrumental strengthening that cannot be presented as that standard comparator condition.

soundness_flags.label: prop:job-corps-radius-nonempty; thm:causal-label-polyhedralization; prop:job-corps-certified-labels
soundness_flags.one_line: Because B has positive rank, p0+Bu leaves the probability simplex for some u, so Xi(p0+Bu) is empty there and the constructed D_v^0 cannot cover R^d; hence G0 does not satisfy the complete-label-cover assumption required for G0∈E.
